LESSON: VOLUME AND CAPACITY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: MEASUREMENTS
Topic 3.4: Volume and Capacity
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Volume and Capacity, part of MEASUREMENTS in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we use volume and capacity in daily activities? 2. Why do we measure volume?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Volume and Capacity together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving: A learner develops interpretation and inference skills as they create a conversion

table of units of volume.

● Creativity and Imagination: A learner develops observation skills as they create models of cubes and cuboids.

Values:
● Responsibility: A learner enhances self-drive as they work in groups and share different tasks in making models.

● Peace: A learner enhances responsibility as they collaboratively discuss on how to make models for different volumes and

capacities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

39

● Environmental education: A learner uses big and small containers of different volumes from locally available resources.

● Safety and security: A learner takes safety precautions as they make models of cubes and cuboids.

● Education for Sustainable Development: A learner practises water conservation using containers of different capacities.

Link to other subjects:

● Creative Arts and Sports: A learner creates models of cubes and cuboids.

● Pre-Technical Studies: A learner creates models of cubes and cuboids.

● Integrated Science: A learner works out the volume of different substances.

Suggested Learning Resources:

● Cuboids, Cubes and Cylinders Realia, digital devices with assistive technology such as magnifiers, refreshable braille

displays, Appropriate Print and Braille, Charts and Containers.
